title: The Weight of Unspoken Rain
setting_summary: In the cliffside city of Verdal, a permanent fog called the Hush descends each dusk and erases any spoken word not recorded in the state's official Ledger, while a silent drought parches the lower districts. Water, memory, and speech are rationed by the Ministry of Quiet, and those who whisper without permission find their shadows confiscated by the fog.
